title: Ade's startup goes for Imagine Cup
caption: Got an AI startup idea? Microsoft Imagine Cup 2027: $250,000 + $1M in credits for 1st place, and a $25,000 Top Student Startup prize 🚀 Deadline 28 Feb 2027. Comment LINK 👇 #imaginecup #startup #ai #microsoft #students

scenes.backdrop: cozy co-working space at night with laptops, sticky notes and neon lights

beats.text: Quddus! My AI app helps farmers detect sick crops from a photo. My mum says I'm a genius.
beats.say: Kuddus! My A.I. app helps farmers detect sick crops from a photo. My mum says I'm a genius.
Your mum is right. Have you heard of the Microsoft Imagine Cup?
Is that a trophy for the best tea mug?

beats.text: It's a global competition for early-stage startups using AI. And the prizes are big.
beats.say: It's a global competition for early-stage startups using A.I.. And the prizes are big.

scenes.backdrop: sunny busy city street with shops, trees and blue sky

beats.say: Two hundred and fifty thousand dollars? For crop photos?
For a strong startup. A founder registers the team, then you build your pitch and demo.

card.title: HOW TO ENTER
lines: 1f310|Read the rules on the official site

beats.say: Do I need to be a big company?
No, it's for early-stage startups. But read the official rules to confirm you're eligible.
Pitch deck mode activated. Farmers, your app is coming!
